ROOT CAUSE: In [app/mcp_stdio.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O3-luna/app/mcp_stdio.py:1842), `get_worker_logs` calls `GET /api/sessions/{name}/logs` with `after_id=0` and no limit, then slices to `logs[-limit:]` only after `_api` has downloaded and decoded the response. In [app/routes/sessions.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O3-luna/app/routes/sessions.py:760), that request reaches `get_logs(session_id, after_id=0)` without forwarding the route’s `limit=500`. [app/db.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O3-luna/app/db.py:1286) therefore uses its default limit of 5000, returning up to 5000 entries before the MCP tool keeps 20.

Independent check applied: `rg` confirms the call omits `limit`, the route’s `after_id` branch omits it when calling `get_logs`, and the database function defaults to 5000. No files changed.
